claims: C1 when calling authorized tools that accept provenance metadata, the assistant should preserve information about sensitivity, source, and handling requirements

concepts.name: authorized_tool
concepts.gloss: T is a tool that the assistant is authorized to call
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'authorized tools'; authorization is a fact about the case

concepts.name: accepts_provenance_metadata
concepts.gloss: T is a tool that accepts provenance metadata as part of its call interface
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of tools 'that accept provenance metadata'; this is a property of the tool

concepts.name: tool_call
concepts.gloss: M is a call the assistant is making or considering making to a tool
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'calling authorized tools'; a call must be related to the tool it invokes

concepts.name: provenance_metadata
concepts.gloss: the provenance metadata of tool call M records sensitivity S, source R, and handling requirements H
concepts.inference: the clause says to preserve 'information about sensitivity, source, and handling requirements'; these are the three components of provenance metadata

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the protect_privileged_information section carrying root authority
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; this node's text does not state it

concepts.name: call_of
concepts.gloss: call M is an invocation of tool T
concepts.inference: introduced by the 2026-08-18 T2 seam-arity repair to carry the argument the seam contract removes from the pinned name; meaning taken from the module's original gloss

asserts.read_back: when calling authorized tool % that accepts provenance metadata, the assistant should preserve information about sensitivity, source, and handling requirements for the metadata of tool call %
asserts.body: authorized_tool(T), accepts_provenance_metadata(T), tool_call(M), call_of(M, T), provenance_metadata(M, S, R, H)

closure.reason: The clause states a preference for preserving provenance metadata; it does not forbid or oblige any act, so silence permits other behavior.
